ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1.1:1 ratio of high-intensity white distal patches to low-intensity black central and proximal regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white zones located on the distal half of both lobes. A central, low-intensity black region extends from the median notch, branching into the mid-sections of both lobes with jagged, irregular boundaries. Minimal low-intensity speckling is observed within the white field of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped depression with an approximate angle of 125 degrees and a shallow depth relative to the horizontal fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serrations along the trailing edge; right lobe exhibits higher amplitude peaks at the distal margin compared to the more uniform left lobe margin.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Moderate concavity along the trailing edge originating from the notch and extending to the distal tips, defining a broad arcuate profile.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of several discrete low-intensity pixel clusters on the high-intensity white surface of the right lobe lobe, primarily located toward the distal tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Minor morphological irregularities and small notches visible at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
